props.name: options
props.description: The maplibre layer specification minus `id`, `type` and `source`. Applied incrementally on change — see `lib/layerDiff.ts`.

props.name: source
props.description: Source id, or a maplibre `Source` instance. Optional inside a `<MglSource>`, which provides it. Only a string id participates in source-readiness tracking.

props.name: anisotropicFilterPitch
props.description: Pitch above which anisotropic texture filtering kicks in, trading fill rate for sharper oblique tiles.

props.name: aroundCenter
props.description: Zoom around the map centre rather than around the pointer.

props.name: attributionControl
props.description: Show the attribution control, or configure it. Attribution is a licence requirement for most tile sources.

props.name: bearing
props.description: Initial bearing (rotation) in degrees counter-clockwise from north. Two-way bindable with `v-model:bearing`.

props.name: bearingSnap
props.description: Snap to north once the bearing is within this many degrees of it.

props.name: bounds
props.description: Fit the map to these bounds instead of using `center` and `zoom`. Two-way bindable with `v-model:bounds`, where reading gives the current viewport and writing fits the map to the box — the fit uses {@link fitBoundsOptions }.

props.name: boxZoom
props.description: Allow shift-drag to zoom to a box.

props.name: cancelPendingTileRequestsWhileZooming
props.description: Abort in-flight tile requests while zooming, rather than letting them complete.

props.name: canvasContextAttributes
props.description: WebGL context attributes, e.g. `{ antialias: true }` or `{ preserveDrawingBuffer: true }` for screenshots.

props.name: center
props.description: Initial centre as `[lng, lat]` or a `LngLat`. Two-way bindable with `v-model:center`.

props.name: centerClampedToGround
props.description: Keep the centre pinned to the ground rather than to the camera target when the terrain moves.

props.name: clickTolerance
props.description: Pointer movement in pixels that still counts as a click rather than a drag.

props.name: collectResourceTiming
props.description: Collect `resourceTiming` data for tile requests and report it on the data events.

props.name: cooperativeGestures
props.description: Require ctrl/⌘ to zoom with the wheel and two fingers to pan, so the map does not hijack page scrolling.

props.name: crossSourceCollisions
props.description: Let labels from different sources collide with each other. Turning this off speeds up label placement.

props.name: doubleClickZoom
props.description: Allow double-click and shift-double-click to zoom.

props.name: dragPan
props.description: Allow panning by dragging.

props.name: dragRotate
props.description: Allow rotating by right-drag or ctrl-drag.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Camera elevation in metres above the terrain.

props.name: fadeDuration
props.description: Cross-fade duration in milliseconds for labels and symbols as tiles change zoom level.

props.name: fitBoundsOptions
props.description: Options for every `fitBounds` this map performs — padding, animation, `maxZoom`. Also shared with the draw plugin for its viewport padding. Set `useOnBoundsUpdate` to reuse these options when `v-model:bounds` writes a new box.

props.name: hash
props.description: Sync the camera to the URL hash (`#zoom/lat/lng`). A string uses it as the parameter name.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the map container. A number is treated as pixels. The map has no intrinsic size — with a percentage height, the *parent* needs a height of its own, or the map collapses to nothing.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Master switch for all user interaction. `false` gives a static map that can still be moved from code.

props.name: keyboard
props.description: Allow keyboard navigation when the map has focus.

props.name: language
props.description: Rewrites every symbol layer's `text-field` to this language, e.g. `'de'`. Not a maplibre option: the expressions are rewritten to `['coalesce', ['get', 'name:de'], ['get', 'name']]`, so it needs a style whose tiles carry `name:xx` fields. Also writeable through `useMap().language`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides for maplibre's own UI strings, e.g. control tooltips.

props.name: localIdeographFontFamily
props.description: Font family used to render CJK glyphs locally instead of loading them from the style's glyph endpoint.

props.name: logoPosition

props.name: mapKey
props.description: Key this map is registered under, so `useMap(key)` can reach it from anywhere. Not a maplibre option. Omit it and the map registers under a default symbol — which is fine until a second map is mounted, at which point both want the same slot.

props.name: maplibreLogo
props.description: Show the maplibre logo. Check the licence of your tile source before turning this off.

props.name: mapStyle
props.description: The style: a URL, or a style specification object. This is maplibre's `style` option. It is called `mapStyle` because `style` is the HTML style attribute; the rename is undone when the map is constructed. Changing it calls `setStyle` with `{ diff: false }`, and sources and layers re-add themselves afterwards.

props.name: maxBounds

props.name: maxCanvasSize

props.name: maxPitch

props.name: maxTileCacheSize

props.description: Map projection, e.g. `{ type: 'globe' }`. props.name: source
props.description: Source id, or a maplibre `Source` instance. Optional inside an `<MglSource>` (or any component using `useSource()`), which provides its id. Only a string id participates in source-readiness tracking — pass a `Source` object and the layer adds itself immediately.

props.name: sourceLayer
props.description: Layer within a vector source to draw. Required for vector and some raster-dem sources. Mapped to maplibre's `source-layer`, which is not a valid identifier. Has no setter either, so changing it recreates the layer.

props.name: autoZoom
props.description: Zoom to the feature after it is drawn or loaded.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Mode to start in when drawing begins.

props.name: minAreaColor
props.description: Colour of the hatch pattern drawn for an area below `minAreaSize`.

props.name: minAreaLabel
props.description: Label shown on an area below `minAreaSize`.

props.name: minAreaSize
props.description: Smallest acceptable area. Below it, the feature is marked `tooSmall` and hatched.

props.name: mode
props.description: Active drawing mode. Two-way bindable, so the control reflects a mode set from code.

props.name: model
props.description: The drawn feature. Two-way bindable with `v-model` — always a closed `Feature<Polygon>`.

props.name: pointerPrecision
props.description: Grab radius in pixels for vertices and midpoints. Defaults to 24 for mouse and 36 for touch.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner of the map the control is placed in.
